readout_other: Wong-Baker thermal pain rating; ultrasound displacement imaging of the median nerve
direction_notes: In one subject, FUS on the median nerve lowered thermal pain ratings by 0.9643 units versus sham without significance (p = 0.0547); off-target ratings were about 1 higher than on-target.

exposures.label: FUS on the median nerve, forearm

device.model: four element, 1.1-MHz FUS transducer (driven by Verasonics Vantage)

timing.protocol_description: A 5-ms FUS pulse built from 70 consecutive 71-microsecond bursts without interval between bursts (a 17-microsecond gap between bursts from electronics; the authors call it a pseudo-CW push), delivered concurrently with a 2-s heat stimulus; 7 FUS pulses per subject for displacement.

source_quotes.n_subjects: All human subjects (n 5) were recruited acquired in accordance with the 2013 Declaration of Helsinki.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Therefore, to generate an image at 41 mm from the transducer face (aperture of 9.94 mm), the TOF (71 μs) sets the extended FUS burst to be an integer multiple of the TOF. To reach a burst pulse duration of 5 ms, matching pulse durations seen in previous PNS neuromodulation studies, 70 bursts of ultrasound without interval between pulse trains were transmitted during the FUS push.
